trigger.description: `ee focus suggest --recent-hours <N>` was passed an N so large that subtracting `Duration::hours(N)` from `Utc::now()` overflowed chrono's representable `DateTime<Utc>` range (~262_143 years on either side of year 0). `--recent-hours` accepts a `u32` (up to ~4.3 billion hours / ~489_957 years), so any value beyond ~262_000 years × 8766 hours/year ≈ 2_296_000_000 trips the bound. The pipeline uses `checked_sub_signed` and falls back to `DateTime::<Utc>::MIN_UTC` so the surface stays usable (the window is effectively treated as all-time); this degraded entry surfaces the clamp so the caller can shrink the window.
